Welcome to Townhill Infant School & Nursery
Welcome to Townhill Infant School & Nursery
Welcome to Townhill Infant School
My name is Beverly Corbin and I am the headteacher of our fantastic school. Our school is a happy, fun place to be where children enjoy coming to learn. The ethos of our school is to inspire success in all our pupils, to develop their personal skills and give them a curriculum which is stimulating and engaging.
The children are at the heart of what we do and all the staff work hard to ensure that the children at our school receive a high quality education and achieve the best they can.
Beverly Corbin Headteacher
Useful Links
Online Payments
Townhill Tips
Term dates
Our Vision
To inspire every child to be a happy, confident, enthusiastic, and curious learner and provide them with a curriculum with topics which allow them to learn and discover the world around them. We believe these will provide all our children with every possibility of a bright future. Our school is a place where every child is valued, every day by everyone.
This vision demonstrates our commitment to ensuring that every child is enabled, every day to achieve their best; to grow and develop both academically, socially, and emotionally to access the wonderful opportunities and possibilities in their next stage of education, higher education and adult life.
Partnerships
Hamwic Education Trust
Townhill Infant School is part of Hamwic Education Trust - one of the largest multi-academy trusts in the South of England. Its academies work in local community partnerships based in Southampton, Portsmouth, Poole and East Dorset.
Hamwic Education Trust celebrates the uniqueness of pupils, staff and schools, and aims for everyone to achieve their full potential through the pathways of opportunities available.

pageCache.text:
Pioneers Breakfast and After School Club
Pioneers Breakfast and After School Club
Pioneers club offers wraparound childcare for pupils at both Townhill Infant and Townhill Junior school. Staffed by experienced childcare professionals who are employed directly by the Infant School, Pioneers club runs term time only and is based in the Infant school.
Breakfast Provision
Runs from 7.30 - 8.45am.
Includes breakfast.
After School Provision
Children attending Townhill Junior School will be walked down to the school ready for the start of the school day and collected at the end of the day. Infant school pupils will be escorted to their classrooms.
All staff are DBS checked.
If you require any further information or to register a place for your child at Pioneers, please email Pioneers@townhill-inf.net or call the Club Supervisor on 07377 917984.
Runs from 3.10 - 5.30pm
Includes a snack.

PE at Townhill
Children
PE at Townhill
At Townhill Infant we are passionate about teaching PE and place a high priority on delivering a well rounded PE curriculum to the children.
Each child will take part in two PE lessons per week and there are a wide range of sporting activities to choose from our after school club programme. Expert sports coaches come into school frequently to ensure staff receive continuing professional development in PE.
We continually strive to encourage the children to take part in an active and healthy lifestyle ensuring many cross curricular links within school.

pageCache.text:
School Attendance Matters
Children
School Attendance Matters
We place a high priority on encouraging our pupils to attend school every day. Our aim is for at least 96% attendance each week and the classes compete to see whose attendance is the highest so they can win Tam'ed The Tiger to sit in their class with them for the week.
Tam'ed stands for Townhill Attendance Matters Every Day. A much bigger Tam'ed The Tiger is on the gate to welcome the children into school every Monday morning!
It is also essential not to be late so that important learning time isn't lost.

The children also compete in classes to have no lateness so that they can win Cotat The Tiger to sit in their class with them for the week. Cotat stands for Come On Time At Townhill.
A much bigger Cotat The Tiger joins Tam'ed on the gate to welcome the children into school every Monday morning!
Attendance Tea Party
Children who achieved 96% or above for attendance enjoyed an exciting tea party with Tam'ed. They had treats and played games.

Meet the governors
Welcome to the Governors' section
The Governors are the immediate authority for various aspects of school management including the school budget and decide many matters.
Up to four of the governors represent the parents and are elected by parents for a four year period of office. The teachers and support staff are also represented, as is the Local Authority. Co-options are possible to ensure that local business or other community interests are represented.
The Governors meet regularly, at least twice a term, and aim to represent the community within the school and the school within the community.

pageCache.pageTitle: Uniform | Townhill Infant and Nursery school
pageCache.text:
Uniform
Uniform
Although school uniform is not compulsory for infant school aged children we would like the children to wear a red sweatshirt or cardigan, white polo shirt, grey trousers/shorts/skirt/pinafore and black shoes. In the warmer months girls can also wear a red/white summer dress.
We do not specify a PE kit but simply ask for parents to provide their child with a t-shirt and pair of shorts to wear during PE lessons. Plimsolls are not needed as children do PE lessons in bare feet, but during the summer term parents will be asked to provide a pair of trainers for their child to wear when PE lessons are taken outside.
Plain versions of sweatshirts, cardigans and polo shirts can be purchased from most of the major supermarkets but if you would like to buy embroidered versions that have our school logo on them on you can buy these online from our uniform supplier Mapac. They also offer a wide range of other uniform items such as skirts, trousers, summer caps and woolly hats, book bags and PE bags.
We will no longer be stocking uniform in school. Mapac aim to dispatch orders within 10 working days and you can choose to have it delivered free of charge to school (during term time only) or, delivered to your home for £3.95, or free of charge if you spend over £50.
If you need to speak to somebody from Mapac's customer services they can be contacted on 01923 255525.
